resolution.note: Cause: krn not callable in the arm C sandbox (host krn is a symlink into an unmounted checkout), so the adopted hooks refused every Bash and Stop. Fixed with a krn shim and ro mounts; rerun: t-11kv38i pass, t-1182p41 attempted (3 tests run), both off no-attempt.

title: Arm C ends no-attempt on units arms A and B attempt
body:
Outcome: find why arm C ends with verdict no-attempt (0 tests run, no change after the re-prompt) on t-11kv38i and t-1182p41 where arm A and B attempted the same units, and fix it. Evidence: the 3-unit live proof of t-08zbqzn (rows 2 of 3 arm-C ungraded, C USD per resolved n/a).
Files: evals/replay/arm-c.ts, evals/replay/arm-session.ts
Proof: a re-run of the two units on arm C writes a graded row, or a test names the cause.
